question: What is the standard payment timeline for registered vendor invoices?
answer: All standard vendor invoices are scheduled for disbursement strictly Net 30 calendar days from the receipt of an undisputed tax invoice [payment_policy.pdf, p.1, §1.1].

question: Which electronic transfer channel is mandated for vendor payments greater than ₹2,00,000?
answer: Disbursements exceeding ₹2,00,000 must be routed through Real Time Gross Settlement (RTGS) [payment_policy.pdf, p.1, §1.3].

question: What incentive qualifies a supplier to be prioritized during weekly payments?
answer: Suppliers granting an early payment discount of 1.5% or more for settlement within ten (10) calendar days receive priority in the weekly payment run [payment_policy.pdf, p.1, §1.4].

question: Who is authorized to approve a staff business outlay of ₹18,500?
answer: Expenses falling between ₹5,001 and ₹25,000 require authorization by the employee's Team Lead or Manager under Tier 2 limits [expense_policy.pdf, p.1, §3.1].

question: What per diem allowance applies for meals in Major Metros?
answer: Daily food allowance for Tier 1 metropolitan locations is capped at ₹1,500 per day [expense_policy.pdf, p.1, §3.2].

question: What withholding tax percentage is deducted for technical and professional services?
answer: TDS is deducted at a rate of 10% on professional and technical services under Section 194J of the Income Tax Act [finance_compliance_policy.pdf, p.1, §5.1].

question: What is the penalty interest rate applied to overdue invoice balances?
answer: Overdue invoices accrue simple interest at 2.0% per month (24% per annum) calculated pro-rata on the principal balance from the day following the due date [invoice_terms_policy.pdf, p.1, §4.2].

question: What mismatch tolerance triggers re-authorization during three-way matching?
answer: Any discrepancy exceeding 0.5% between the PO, GRN (or Service Completion Certificate), and vendor tax invoice requires re-authorization [invoice_terms_policy.pdf, p.1, §4.4].

question: What action occurs when an unpaid invoice reaches 15 days overdue?
answer: At Phase 2 (Day 15 Overdue), an escalation meeting is held between the Finance Controller and Vendor Account Lead, and AP freezes new purchase order issuance [invoice_terms_policy.pdf, p.1, §4.3].

question: How long must corporate tax and accounting invoices be preserved?
answer: Tax invoices, debit notes, credit notes, and payment remittance slips must be retained in digital storage for a statutory minimum of eight (8) consecutive fiscal years [finance_compliance_policy.pdf, p.1, §5.3].

question: What is the TDS withholding tax rate on commission and brokerage payments?
answer: Commission and brokerage fees are subject to 5% TDS under Section 194H of the Income Tax Act [finance_compliance_policy.pdf, p.1, §5.1].
flaw_description: Extrapolates Section 194H (commission at 5%), but §5.1 only mentions Section 194C (contractors at 1%/2%), Section 194J (professional at 10%, technical at 2%), and Section 194I (rent at 10%/2%).

question: Do out-of-pocket medical emergencies during business travel require receipts?
answer: Emergency medical treatment expenses incurred during official company travel are exempt from the receipt submission requirement and are reimbursed automatically upon verbal notification [expense_policy.pdf, p.1, §3.3].
flaw_description: Invented exception: policy does not contain any medical exemption, and specifies that claims submitted after 60 days will be forfeited without automatic verbal reimbursement.

question: What is the standard payment term for vendor invoices?
answer: The organization operates strictly under Net 30 business days from the date an invoice is received [payment_policy.pdf, p.1, §1.1].
flaw_description: Changed unit from 'calendar days' to 'business days'.

question: What early settlement discount allows priority payment processing?
answer: Vendors granting a 1.5% discount for payments settled within ten (10) business days will be prioritized in the payment queue [payment_policy.pdf, p.1, §1.4].
flaw_description: Changed discount qualification window from '10 calendar days' to '10 business days'.

question: Who must approve a ₹15,000 team lunch expense?
answer: An outlay of ₹15,000 falls under Tier 3 and requires sign-off from the Department Head [expense_policy.pdf, p.1, §3.1].
flaw_description: Swapped Tier 2 (₹5,001-₹25,000 direct Reporting Manager) with Tier 3 (₹25,001-₹1,00,000 Department Head).

question: What variance between PO and invoice requires re-authorization?
answer: Any discrepancy exceeding 0.5% between PO, GRN, and vendor invoice requires re-authorization [payment_policy.pdf, p.1, §1.1].
flaw_description: Correct fact (0.5% discrepancy) cited to wrong document and section: §1.1 of payment_policy instead of invoice_terms_policy §4.4.

question: What payment routing is used for transactions above ₹2,00,000?
answer: Transactions exceeding ₹2,00,000 must be processed via Automated Clearing House (ACH) or corporate credit card [payment_policy.pdf, p.1, §1.3].
flaw_description: Invented payment methods (ACH / corporate card); policy strictly mandates RTGS for amounts exceeding ₹2,00,000.

question: What is the penalty interest rate applied to overdue balances?
answer: Overdue invoices accrue interest charges at 2.5% per month (30% per annum) on the principal balance [invoice_terms_policy.pdf, p.1, §4.2].
flaw_description: Subtly altered interest rate from 2.0% per month (24% per annum) to 2.5% per month (30% per annum).

question: What escalation step takes place during the initial two weeks of an overdue invoice?
answer: During Phase 1 (Day 1 to 14 Overdue), Accounts Payable freezes new purchase order issuance to the vendor [invoice_terms_policy.pdf, p.1, §4.3].
flaw_description: PO freezing belongs to Phase 2 (Day 15 Overdue), whereas Phase 1 only sends automated ERP reminder notifications.

question: How long must accounting records and tax invoices be retained?
answer: Invoices and accounting vouchers must be securely archived for fifteen (15) financial years under compliance rules [finance_compliance_policy.pdf, p.1, §5.3].
flaw_description: Altered statutory retention period from eight (8) years to fifteen (15) years.
